Title: A Slice of Inadvertence

Characters:

* JIM, a pizza clerk
* SARAH, a customer

(Scene: A busy pizzeria. Jim is restocking the coupons on the counter while Sarah waits for her pizza.)

SARAH:
Hey, can I just get my order in?

JIM:
Yeah, that's okay...I'll go put it together for you.

(Sarah nods and starts to wait. Jim begins to expertly weave a piece of paper into a neat coupon folder.)

JIM:
So, what kind of pizza do you want?

SARAH:
Uh, just a large pepperoni.

JIM:
Okay... that's a standard order.

(Jim picks up the phone to call the kitchen. As he does, he accidentally knocks over a stack of coupons, causing papers to flutter on the counter.)

JIM:
Oh no! Sorry about this...

SARAH:
It's okay, I'm just here for my pizza.

JIM:
Right... sorry again. (pauses) You know what would be great right now?

SARAH:
What's that?

JIM:
A slice of pie... straight from the oven!

(Sarah's eyes widen in surprise.)

SARAH:
Uh... no, I don't think so...

JIM:
But just heard it said on the radio! Oven!

(The words hang in the air as Sarah looks at Jim with a mix of amusement and embarrassment.)

SARAH:
(laughs nervously)
Oh, Jim...

JIM:
(awkwardly chuckling) Oh... yeah.

(Sarah quickly pays for her pizza and leaves. Jim is left standing alone on the counter, looking sheepish.)

(The scene ends with Jim shaking his head, muttering to himself.)

JIM:
(sighs) Note to self: never reveal the secret coupon word again

Title: The Pizza Paradox

Characters:

* JIM, a pizza clerk
* SARAH, a curious customer

(The scene takes place in a cozy pizzeria. Jim is ringing up an order while Sarah waits patiently.)

SARAH:
So, I'm looking for the 20% off coupon.

JIM:
(scratching his head) Um... oh, you mean the one that's, uh...

SARAH:
(frustrated)
No, it's right here! You know it.

JIM:
(shrugging) I don't think so. I'm just trying to ring up your order.

(Sarah glances at her coupon, then back at Jim.)

SARAH:
(teasingly)
Oh, come on. You're not buying a pie for yourself, are you?

JIM:
(defensively)
Hey, it's just a pizza! It's not that expensive.

SARAH:
(skeptical)
A pizza? You think I'd buy a pizza if I knew about this coupon? That's like me knowing about your secret sauce recipe!

(Jim looks at the coupon again, then nervously glances around the restaurant.)

JIM:
(whispering) Okay, okay... (pauses) Oven...

SARAH:
(stunned)
What?!

JIM:
(quickly covering) Oh, uh, nothing. Just a coincidence.

SARAH:
(doubtful)
A coincidence? You said "oven" out loud!

(Jim looks sheepish, then quickly tries to cover again.)

JIM:
(mumbling) Never mind...

(Sarah raises an eyebrow, intrigued.)

SARAH:
(finally giving up)
I think I'm going to have to go somewhere else.

(Jim hands her the order and wishes her a good day. Sarah leaves the pizzeria, still chuckling.)

(The scene fades to black as Jim looks on nervously.)

JIM: (laughing awkwardly) Oh, uh... no, no, nothing like that. Just the weather. Yeah.

(The customer laughs some more, and Jim continues to work, trying to brush off the incident.)

**(Scene closes with Jim looking sheepish.)**

Title: A Slice of Inadvertence

Characters:

* JIM, a pizza clerk
* SARAH, a customer

(Scene: A busy pizzeria. Jim is restocking the coupons on the counter while Sarah waits for her pizza.)

SARAH:
Hey, can I just get my order in?

JIM:
Yeah, that's okay...I'll go put it together for you.

(Sarah nods and starts to wait. Jim begins to expertly weave a piece of paper into a neat coupon folder.)

JIM:
So, what kind of pizza do you want?

SARAH:
Uh, just a large pepperoni.

JIM:
Okay... that's a standard order.

(Jim picks up the phone to call the kitchen. As he does, he accidentally knocks over a stack of coupons, causing papers to flutter on the counter.)

JIM:
Oh no! Sorry about this...

SARAH:
It's okay, I'm just here for my pizza.

JIM:
Right... sorry again. (pauses) You know what would be great right now?

SARAH:
What's that?

JIM:
A slice of pie... straight from the oven!

(Sarah's eyes widen in surprise.)

SARAH:
Uh... no, I don't think so...

JIM:
But just heard it said on the radio! Oven!

(The words hang in the air as Sarah looks at Jim with a mix of amusement and embarrassment.)

SARAH:
(laughs nervously)
Oh, Jim...

JIM:
(awkwardly chuckling) Oh... yeah.

(Sarah quickly pays for her pizza and leaves. Jim is left standing alone on the counter, looking sheepish.)

(The scene ends with Jim shaking his head, muttering to himself.)

JIM:
(sighs) Note to self: never reveal the secret coupon word again
